content:
olivia_sales: Hey team — need a hosted API key for a 2-week POC with NovaHealth starting next Monday. Customer wants a short-lived key + clear rotation/revoke process. @anya_security can you confirm requirements?

tom_se: I can create via console or admin API. Recommend API so sales can script rotation. Do they need IP allowlist or limited scopes?

anya_security: For enterprise POCs we require keys expire <= 14 days by default, audit logs enabled. If customer expects PHI, we should push Private deployment. For non-PHI hosted is OK but require: expiry, owner contact, and revocation flow. Tagging @kevin_infra to provision.

kevin_infra: I can provision a scoped key and set expiry + metadata. We use the admin API / internal console. Example (admin-only):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/admin/api-keys \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"nova-poc-olivia","scopes":["inference:all"],"expires_in":1209600,"metadata":{"team":"sales","customer":"novahealth"}}'
```
I'll default to 14 days unless you ask for shorter.

olivia_sales: Can we do 7 days instead? Customer prefers weekly rotation during the POC.

kevin_infra: Sure — set expires_in to 604800 (7d). Rotation process is revoke old + create new. No built-in atomic rotate endpoint currently. Example revoke + create: 
```bash
# revoke
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/admin/api-keys/<key_id>/revoke -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN'
# create new (same payload as above)
```
We'll add a note on the created key with rotation owner.

jen_support: Adding doc pointer: https://docs.redwood.ai/poc/keys — includes step-by-step for provisioning, rotation, and audit expectations. Also recommend adding the key to the POC runbook in console under "POC keys".

olivia_sales: Any formal approvals needed? NovaHealth security asked for rotation logs and ability to request immediate revocation.

anya_security: Approvals: for non-PHI hosted POC, security sign-off is implicit if checklist met (owner, expiry <=7d if requested, audit logs on, contact info). If PHI or regulated data -> escalate to Compliance and require Private. Please ensure customer contact is listed and we set email alerts to security ops on manual revokes.

tom_se: I'll put together a tiny script to automate revoke/create and POST a Slack webhook on rotate. Will share with Olivia tonight.

poc-provision-bot: API key created: id=ak_2026pocxyz, name=nova-poc-olivia, expires_at=1815111589, created_by=kevin_infra

olivia_sales: Received the key, shared with the POC team (out-of-band). Adding rotation steps to the POC runbook. Thanks all :lock:
